patch.description: Updates the service-created PostgreSQL username-and-password authentication method. The request is sparse and omitted properties preserve their current values. A state-only request enables or disables the authentication mechanism; disabling cannot include credentials and does not remove or modify existing database users or roles. Login-only, password-only, and combined credential updates require this method to already be Enabled unless this request also sets state to Enabled. PostgreSQL is the sole source of truth; the control plane stores no administrator identity or credentials. The service bootstraps an AzureSU-owned special group, only AzureSU can grant or revoke its membership, and at most one user role can be a member. Login-only or password-only updates require exactly one current member. A combined administratorLogin and administratorLoginPassword request creates and adds a new user when no member exists, resets the password when the member name matches, or renames the member and resets its password when names differ. A requested name that already exists outside the special group is rejected to prevent privilege elevation. Both authentication methods may be Disabled.

PasswordAuthenticationProperties.description: Properties of the service-created PostgreSQL username-and-password authentication method. The control plane stores no administrator identity; PostgreSQL is the source of truth for the sole member of the service-owned administrator role.

state.description: The state of PostgreSQL username-and-password authentication.

PasswordAuthenticationPropertiesForPatch.description: Properties for updating PostgreSQL username-and-password authentication. Omitted properties preserve their current values. State-only requests enable or disable the authentication mechanism. Credentials are secrets and are never returned or stored by the control plane. Login-only, password-only, and combined credential updates require this authentication method to already be Enabled unless the request also sets state to Enabled.

state.description: The target password-authentication state. Enabled or Disabled can be supplied without credentials to toggle the feature. Disabled cannot be combined with administratorLogin or administratorLoginPassword. Disabling password authentication does not remove or modify existing database users or roles.

administratorLogin.description: The PostgreSQL administrator role name. A login-only update requires password authentication to already be Enabled unless state is set to Enabled in this request, and requires exactly one member in the AzureSU-owned special group. The current name is an idempotent no-op; a different name renames the current member only when that target role does not already exist. When supplied together with administratorLoginPassword, this value can create the administrator if the special group has no member, reset the matching member's password, or rename a differently named member and reset its password.

administratorLoginPassword.description: The PostgreSQL administrator password. A password-only update requires password authentication to already be Enabled unless state is set to Enabled in this request, and requires exactly one member in the AzureSU-owned special group. When supplied together with administratorLogin, it can create the administrator if the special group has no member, reset the matching member's password, or rename a differently named member and reset its password.
